# pve_node_time (Resource)

Node time zone and NTP servers (singleton).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_time" "example" {
  node     = "pve1"
  timezone = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone. The file '/usr/share/zoneinfo/zone.tab' contains the list of valid names.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node (also the `terraform import` format).
- `localtime` (Number) Seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 (local time)
- `time` (Number) Seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
